headline.en: UNI trapped by net inflation: 18M token annual dilution at $6.72 overwhelms burn narrative, no catalyst visible
headline.zh: UNI 陷入净增发困境：当前价格下年净增发 1800 万枚代币压倒回购销毁叙事，无催化剂在望

keyChanges.en: Net emission remains highly inflationary: 18.05M UNI/year (+2.04% supply growth) at current price, creating $121M annual structural sell pressure
keyChanges.zh: 净增发仍高度通胀：当前价格下年净增发 1805 万 UNI（+2.04% 供应增长），形成 1.21 亿美元年度结构性抛压

keyChanges.en: Derivatives show dead money: OI at $36.27M with 0.00% funding despite 2.36 long/short ratio indicates no momentum either direction
keyChanges.zh: 衍生品呈现死钱状态：持仓量 3627 万美元、资金费率 0.00%，尽管多空比 2.36，显示双向均无动能

keyChanges.en: TVL declined 2.51% week-over-week to $4.11B while protocol revenue dropped to $1.48M (7d), suggesting DeFi activity contraction
keyChanges.zh: TVL 周环比下跌 2.51% 至 41.1 亿美元，协议收入降至 148 万美元（7 日），显示 DeFi 活动收缩

contrarianObservation.en: UNI trades at 0.88x FDV ($4.19B/$5.96B), pricing in 12% dilution despite only 11.3% locked supply—if a real-yield proposal passes, this discount vanishes and UNI re-rates to DCF valuation as the first major DEX distributing actual yield, potentially 2-3x; the 2.36 long/short ratio at 0% funding suggests smart money is positioned for this catalyst without getting shaken out
contrarianObservation.zh: UNI 交易于 0.88 倍 FDV（41.9 亿美元/59.6 亿美元），定价 12% 稀释风险但锁仓仅 11.3%——若真实收益提案通过，该折价消失，UNI 将作为首个分配实际收益的主流 DEX 重估至 DCF 估值模型，潜在 2-3 倍空间；2.36 多空比且资金费率 0% 表明聪明钱已布局此催化剂且未被震出

watchNext.en: Real-yield governance proposal: any RFC converting buyback-to-burn into buyback-to-staker distribution is the only true catalyst that shifts valuation regime
watchNext.zh: 真实收益治理提案：任何将回购销毁转为回购分配给质押者的 RFC 是唯一改变估值范式的真正催化剂

watchNext.en: Net emission crossover: monitor if protocol revenue growth or price decline reaches the inflection point where annual burn > 20M emission
watchNext.zh: 净增发拐点：监测协议收入增长或价格下跌是否触及年度销毁量 > 2000 万增发量的临界点

watchNext.en: $5.96 support test: break below treasury burn cost triggers capitulation toward $4-5 accumulation zone
watchNext.zh: $5.96 支撑测试：跌破财库销毁成本将触发向 $4-5 吸筹区的投降

fullReasoning.en: UNI sits in a structural trap. Despite the fee switch activation and 100M token burn, the protocol remains net inflationary by 18M tokens annually at current price ($6.72), creating ~$121M of sell pressure that overwhelms the buyback narrative. Volume is anemic at $10.65M (0.25% of mcap), funding sits at 0.00% despite 2.36x more longs than shorts, and TVL is contracting (-2.51% weekly). Macro conditions amplify the weakness: BTC dominance at 59.52% and ETH at $2.33K leave little oxygen for DeFi governance tokens. Price holds above the $5.96 treasury cost anchor, but this represents a floor, not a magnet for upside. The absence of active real-yield proposals in governance removes the one catalyst that could shift UNI from reflexive PE-multiple valuation to cash-flow DCF valuation. Until that governance shift materializes or protocol revenue increases 10x, UNI faces persistent selling into emissions. The market has had months to re-rate post-burn and hasn't—the inflation math is why. Short-term directional bias is bearish toward the $5.50-$6.00 range, though the risk/reward could flip instantly if a real-yield RFC surfaces. For now, this is dead money absent a catalyst.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 陷入结构性困境。尽管费用开关已激活并销毁 1 亿枚代币，但在当前价格（$6.72）下协议年度净增发仍达 1800 万枚，形成约 1.21 亿美元抛压，压倒回购叙事。成交量低迷，仅 1065 万美元（占市值 0.25%），资金费率 0.00% 尽管多空比 2.36，TVL 周度收缩 2.51%。宏观环境加剧弱势：BTC 统治力 59.52%、ETH 位于 $2330，DeFi 治理代币几无生存空间。价格守住 $5.96 财库成本锚点，但这是底线而非上行磁铁。治理层面缺乏活跃的真实收益提案，移除了将 UNI 从反身性 PE 倍数估值转向现金流 DCF 估值的唯一催化剂。在治理转向实现或协议收入增长 10 倍之前，UNI 持续面临增发带来的抛售。市场已有数月时间对销毁后重估但未能实现——增发数学是根本原因。短期方向偏空，目标 $5.50-$6.00 区间，尽管若真实收益 RFC 出现风险收益比可瞬间翻转。当前无催化剂即为死钱。
